name: Seated Lower Back Stretch
steps: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with your feet planted wider than shoulder-width and flat on the floor.
Relax your shoulders and slowly fold your torso forward between your thighs, letting your arms hang heavily toward the floor.
Allow your head, neck, and lower back to release gently until you feel a comfortable stretch along your spine.
Hold the position with slow, deep breaths, then brace your core lightly and roll smoothly back up to sitting.
tips: Move slowly when rolling back upright so you do not feel dizzy or strain your lower back.
Stop immediately if folding forward causes sharp pain rather than mild muscular relief.
